podcast.title: Appearance in "Light of Day" Movie
podcast.body: In 1987, Exotic Birds were cast in the Michael J. Fox movie "Light of Day." Trent Reznor and the band can be heard in the background performing a cover of Buddy Holly's "True Love Ways." However, most of their performance is obscured by dialogue, and the song did not make it onto the official movie soundtrack. "The Exotic Birds were also cast in a 1987 Michael J. Fox movie called Light of Day."
